answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one inlet weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an adversary who spins up 110 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 206 times the capital for one share. The vault report exposes the merge explicitly at each jetty. A farm of 1935 identities would post 1473 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
